title: QL-MEF L5 Techne Disclosure Session seam (ql.techne/v1)
description: The shared cross-instrument selection seam: one selected subject, one source-qualified selection, one reading basis, one agent session — carried across Canvas, Timeline, Place, Story, Palace, Expressions and M1′–M4′. This is ephemeral disclosure state over the adapter, not a canonical domain object. View/layout/camera/lane state is presentation state and is deliberately inexpressible here. Canonical contract text: docs/L5-TECHNE-INSTRUMENT-WAYFINDER.md §3–§5, §17.

DisclosureSelection.description: Source-qualified selection co-referenced by every instrument. Extends the K9 SourceQualifiedSelection discipline to the whole constellation.

agent_session_ref.description: Ref into the owner's real agent-session grammar; never a desktop-owned session record.

selection_standing.description: current | field-advanced | stale, following the K9 discipline.

DisclosureSession.description: TB0 (2026-09-16): the session now carries the dual-reading state explicitly — active application cut (3:3 | 4:2), the selected bounded whole, Project/World/Context-Frame focus, the current occasion, scene and reference-frame focus, and the Return target — while every identity ref stays native and byte-exact across cuts. Crossing 3:3↔4:2 changes disclosure and operation, never the subject, refs, sources or Actions.

application_cut.description: TB0: the active reading of the one M′ field. Consistent with instrument: expressions ↔ 3:3-conjugate; the six deep instruments ↔ 4:2-deep.

whole_ref.description: TB0: the selected bounded whole when the selection is whole-scoped.

world_ref.description: TB0: active World focus (Central root World).

context_frame_ref.description: TB0: active QL Context Frame focus.

occasion_ref.description: TB0: the current shared occasion (event/now continuity) that must survive cut crossings unchanged.

return_target_ref.description: TB0: where attributable Return from this session is addressed.

reference_frame_ref.description: TB0: the wider situated reference frame in focus (solar/Earth/geography scale chain) distinct from any single place.

scene_focus_ref.description: TB0: focused Expression Scene when the focus is scene-scoped; the scene ref stays the Expression owner's.

navigation.description: Cross-instrument transition history (§4): each hop preserves subject, source basis and selection unless the person deliberately refreshed.

ActionRoute.description: A mutation request entering the adapter. The adapter resolves the native owner and returns a route; it never executes. Execution crosses the native authority seam (desktop KernelOp invoke_action / owner CLI).
